Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results that described Defective by Design as a joint initiative by the Free Software Foundation (FSF) and CivicActions, and incorrectly singled out CivicActions as “the organization that founded” the campaign. This led them to trace CivicActions’ founders (Henry Poole/Aaron Pava) instead of the FSF’s founder, Richard Stallman, despite their initial correct understanding. This entity conflation produced the wrong final answer.
